variables.name: encounter_id
variables.label: Encounter identifier
variables.definition: Unique key for an encounter-level record.

variables.name: age_years
variables.label: Age
variables.definition: Age at the prespecified index date.

variables.name: encounter_date
variables.label: Encounter date
variables.definition: Calendar date on which the encounter occurred.

variables.name: systolic_bp_mmhg
variables.label: Systolic blood pressure
variables.definition: Systolic blood pressure measured using the protocol-defined method.

validation.note: Broad data plausibility screen, not a clinical reference interval.

variables.name: diastolic_bp_mmhg
variables.label: Diastolic blood pressure
variables.definition: Diastolic blood pressure measured using the protocol-defined method.

validation.note: Broad data plausibility screen, not a clinical reference interval.

variables.name: exposure_group
variables.label: Exposure group
variables.definition: Prespecified exposure classification at the defined time origin.

variables.name: primary_outcome
variables.label: Primary outcome
variables.definition: Whether the protocol-defined primary outcome occurred in its specified window.
